findings.text: follow-on: _locus_segment_kind and _iter_operators duplicate terms._locus_segment_kind (terms.py:201) and terms._iter_operators (terms.py:174) while the same module imports the accessor's _qualifier_segment_kind, so the token walk remains a partially copied enumeration; the brief retained the walk, so this does not block, but reading the accessor's two helpers would end the residual copy.

follow-on: _walk yields the base token unconditionally, so the placeholder base the parser assigns to binary-operator names is listed in concepts (8 names) and notation although select_conventions' _ir_tokens skips a placeholder base and no entry can ever match it, leaving a concepts item that can never close; the fragment documents this at its placeholder note and the worker logged it as a follow_on, so it is the coordinator's call rather than a defect of this change.

follow-on: every roster name is parsed at :146 and then re-parsed inside select_conventions at :171, so the census parses the 219-name roster twice per run; it is a wasted re-parse, not a correctness defect, and passing the already-parsed IR would remove it.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base a7de878b2; 64b626517 removes _filled_segments and _template_matches and adds the select_conventions call plus the rerun results JSON, and 471c15211 adds only the fragment HTML, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks the driver to stop defining the two copies, to re-run live with a reproducing second run and EXIT=, to keep a ratio-deleted gap-control log, and to gate test_conventions_registry.py at base and head by delta; the manifest records all of these and I re-verified the gate logs (2 passed EXIT=0 both arms) and byte-identical results across runs 1-3 and the two default-out runs.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make the registry worklist driver decide template presence through the selector the pipeline uses, and shs-registry-worklist-run.py:171 replaces the removed _filled_segments/_template_matches with select_conventions(name, registry=reg).templates.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the parsed record at the reviewed run dir; it states status complete, a landing line, the base/head gate logs, the gap-control note and follow_ons, and its changed_paths match the diff.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares the driver .py, the rerun-results .json and the fragment .html; the two commits (64b626517, 471c15211) touch exactly those three paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: no test reaches the driver (the brief states this and the gate is an environment check only), and the ratio-deleted gap control does not distinguish the new selector from the removed matcher, so nothing reddens if shs-registry-worklist-run.py:171 is reverted.
justifications.evidence: the gate logs gate-base.log and gate-head.log both read 2 passed EXIT=0 at their stated revisions and I re-verified run1/run2/run3 and the default-out results are byte-identical, so the reproduction the done_when asks for is recorded, not claimed.
justifications.fit: the driver keeps the surrounding module style and imports the accessor's _qualifier_segment_kind at shs-registry-worklist-run.py:100 while redefining a local _locus_segment_kind at :77, a small inconsistency inside an otherwise consistent file.
justifications.goal_fidelity: shs-registry-worklist-run.py:171 decides template presence from select_conventions(name, registry=reg).templates, so the selector the pipeline calls is the sole authority and the copies the goal named are gone.
justifications.reuse: shs-registry-worklist-run.py:171 extends the owner of template selection rather than forking it, and the residual token walk at :93-113 is the walk the brief directed be kept.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff a7de878b2..471c15211 over both commits touches only the three declared write paths, and the first run's shs-registry-worklist-results.json and .html are left intact.
